sentences.text: MS-13 -LRB- Mara Salvatrucha ; also known as simply MS or Mara -RRB- is an international criminal gang that originated in Los Angeles , California , US in the 1980s .	criminal gang	Street gang
The gang later spread to many parts of the continental United States , Canada , Mexico , and Central America , and is active in urban and suburban areas .	Central America	Central America
Most members are ethnically of Central American origin -LRB- principally El Salvador -RRB- .	El Salvador	El Salvador

In the U.S. , the MS-13 has an especially heavy presence in Los Angeles County and the San Francisco Bay Area in California ; the Washington , D.C. metropolitan areas of Fairfax County , Virginia , Montgomery County , Maryland , and Prince George 's County , Maryland ; Queens , New York ; Long Island , New York ; Newark , New Jersey , Plainfield , New Jersey ; Jersey City , New Jersey ; Elizabeth , New Jersey ; the Boston , Massachusetts area ; Charlotte , North Carolina ; and Houston , Texas .	Los Angeles County	Los Angeles County	San Francisco Bay Area	San Francisco Bay Area
There is also a presence of MS-13 in Toronto , Ontario , Canada .
Members of MS are characterised by tattoos covering the body and also often the face , and by the use of their own sign language .	sign language	gang signal#Hand_signs
They are notorious for their use of violence and a subcultural moral code that predominantly consists of merciless revenge and cruel retributions .	subcultural	subculture	moral code	moral code

This cruelty of the distinguished members of the `` Maras '' or `` Mareros '' earned them a path to be recruited by the Sinaloa Cartel battling against Los Zetas in an ongoing drug war in Mexico .	Sinaloa Cartel	Sinaloa Cartel	Los Zetas	Los Zetas	Maras	Mara (gang)	an ongoing drug war	Mexican Drug War

Their wide-ranging activities have drawn the attention of the FBI and Immigration and Customs Enforcement , who have initiated wide-scale raids against known and suspected gang members , arresting hundreds across the country .
